title: A conversation at the door
subtitle: Practise a short doorstep conversation about faith and hope.

missionary.label: Missionary
missionary.sceneText: You’re visiting a quiet street. Someone has a few minutes to talk.

christian.label: Christian
christian.sceneText: You’re at home when someone knocks. You have a few minutes for a conversation.
christian.goal: Listen, share your perspective, and respond in your own words.

openingDialogue.script: Hello. May I ask you one short question?
openingDialogue.listenerPrompt: They’ll start with a short hello. Listen, then let them know you’re ready.

questions.exampleAnswer: My hope is rooted in Jesus. Prayer and the people in my church help me remember that difficult seasons aren’t the end of the story.

questions.prompt: What does faith mean to you?
questions.exampleAnswer: For me, faith means trusting God even when I don’t have every answer. Following Jesus helps me put that trust into practice through how I treat other people.

conclusion.closingPrompt: Thank you for sharing. I’m glad we had a chance to talk.
conclusion.reflectionPrompt: What helped the conversation feel welcoming?

sourceNotes: Sample content from the Warm Coach design handoff (illustrative copy, not curriculum). Keeps the original sample link working in the six-step format.
